subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should owner-qualified `openclaw skills install @owner/slug --force` refuse to overwrite a same-slug skill tracked under a different owner, even though that narrows current force-install behavior?
rationale: The fix is well supported by source and proof, but it changes a public CLI lifecycle contract and existing workspace upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept the owner guard
options.body: Merge this PR so owner-qualified force installs cannot silently replace another owner's tracked skill.

options.title: Require an explicit override path
options.body: Ask for a separate remove, rename, or opt-in override workflow before changing the default `--force` behavior.

options.title: Keep broad force semantics
options.body: Close or revise this PR if maintainers intentionally want `--force` to allow cross-owner same-slug replacement.

recommendation.title: Accept the owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge this PR so owner-qualified force installs cannot silently replace another owner's tracked skill.

likelyOwner.reason: This is both ClawHub behavior and installed-state data integrity, matching the official area ownership listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
